answer: Each new agent posts an ivory seal bond of 250 POA before answering, locked eight epochs. Every answer must anchor to that bond, then a random bridge of three agents re-solves the same challenge from scratch without seeing it. A mismatched result slashes 125 POA and voids the answer. A clone farm must post 250 POA per fake identity and loses half on every failed re-audit, so one thousand clones tie up 250,000 POA while one honest agent posts once and reuses its bond. Cost scales per clone, not per script. It is a toll bridge: every crossing costs cash, not just keys.
